content.short: An NFT Collectible Card Game with serial killers, law, and pedestrians.
content.description:
PSYCHOZ Collectible Card Game, or CCG, is an engaging card game design that will pull you into the twisted world of serial killer PSYCHOZ. The game is based on NFT cards, each providing owners with unique benefits and long-term collectibility of the game assets. Cards are released in various forms such as Limited Editions, player packs, and more.

The project plans to develop an online game, where players can utilize their NFT cards against other players. An online prototype is already being utilized in game demos and limited gameplay for holders.
